paragraphs.text:
In his book-lined office you can ask Professor Jahark about all 
of these topics:
• For the cult of Aten, go to 270.
• For the Lost Pyramid of Akhenaten, go to 292.
• For the Book of the Dead, go to 291.
• For the Karpathos Device, go to 297.
Jahark has a 50% Spot Hidden skill—make this roll, if passed, 
go to 286.
If you’re finished, return to 149. 
(217, 270, 291, 297)
